source.title: Social place-cells in the bat hippocampus

confidence_rationale: Strong, direct evidence that a nervous system carries a dedicated representation of ANOTHER agent's state, in the same allocentric format it uses for the world -- which is the core of ARC-083's 'other-as-a-special-case-of-the-object-file'. Marked mixed rather than supports because roughly half of these social place-cells ALSO encoded the observer's own position: the biological implementation is a partially shared code, not the cleanly segregated token-keyed slot ARC-083 posits. Held at 0.60 because mapping fidelity is the binding constraint for an architectural claim -- the paper evidences one field of the proposed slot (spatial state of agent j) and none of the others (harm, drive, commitment chain).
failure_signatures: About half of the cells representing the other bat's position also represented the observer's own position, so the biological code for 'other' is not disjoint from the code for 'self' -- an architecture that allocates agent j a wholly separate slot is not what the hippocampus does.

The recordings establish an allocentric code for the other agent's POSITION only; nothing in them speaks to the non-spatial fields (z_harm_a_j, drive, commitment chain) that ARC-083's slot also asserts, so the slot as specified is under-evidenced even where the claim is supported.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Recording from dorsal CA1 in bats while an observer bat watched a demonstrator bat fly to a goal, the authors found a neuronal subpopulation representing the position of the OTHER bat in allocentric coordinates. About half of these 'social place-cells' also represented the observer's own position.
mapping.ree_translation: Partially supports ARC-083's PILLAR-4 commitment that another agent is carried as its own token-keyed slot within the ARC-080 object-file machinery. The load-bearing correspondence is FORMAT: the other agent is encoded in the same allocentric frame the animal uses for places and objects, which is what licenses treating other-as-object rather than as a separate subsystem. The load-bearing DISSONANCE is separability: the code is partly shared with self, so REE's clean per-agent slot is an idealisation of a partially entangled biological code.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Bat dorsal CA1 during an observational spatial task, transferred to a V4 agent architecture that does not yet exist. Only the spatial field of the proposed slot is evidenced. Critically, whether these cells are AGENT-specific or would equally track any behaviourally relevant moving object is the question ARC-083 most needs answered, and the abstract alone does not settle it -- if they track any moving object, this is evidence for the ARC-080 object-file generally and NOT for an others-specific specialisation.
mapping.source_context: Bat; dorsal CA1 single-unit recording; observational spatial task with a demonstrator conspecific.

confidence_components.notes: Science, Ulanovsky lab, careful design -- source quality near ceiling. Mapping and transfer are what hold confidence down: an architectural V4 commitment is being supported by rodent-order electrophysiology of one slot field.
